_comment: Distribution layer. The same skills + sources of truth are served as MCP resources so Slack, IDE, dashboards, and standalone agents give the SAME answer. On merge, CI re-publishes these (also to the plugin marketplace + cloud-storage blobs).

_tools.list_metrics: return governed metric catalog (name, description, dimensions, owner, tier)
_tools.compile_metric: compile {metric, dimensions, filters, grain} -> SQL and run read-only; returns rows + the SQL + freshness
_tools.resolve_entity: map a noun -> entity + join paths from entities_graph.yml
_tools.source_freshness: max date + freshness status per source (for the provenance footer)

_tools.rank_tables: rank candidate tables by downstream refs + centrality + certified/canonical
_tools.lineage: parents/children + column-level lineage for a model
